# *I am so excited*! 

Awardee to the Access Grant ---Imaging 4 All funding programme---, to support a scientific research visit to Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine, Chicago, USA.

*Financed by the Wellcome Trust (UK) and administered by Global Biolmaging - European Molecular Biology Laboratory, EMBL (Germany)*.

**Associate Editor**. El Infocito

![](/images/editora.png){width="500"}

**Position:** Postdoctoral Fellow in the Inmunometabolism Laboratory at Hospital Infantil de México.

I am an Immunologist studying how the immune responses modulate adipocytes development during obesity. I also am interested in flow cytometry and science communication (I'm the mastermind behind the [omc lab](https://www.instagram.com/omc_lab/) instagram account). I'm a member of the National Research System (SNII-C), the Mexican Society for Immunology, and the Society for Mucosal Immunology. I earned my Ph.D. in Immunology at the Biological Sciences National School.

## Publications
```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
#| message: false
#| warning: false

library(RefManageR)

# 1. Load your master references.bib file
bib <- ReadBib("/Users/os/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/OMC Lab/website/OMC.Lab/publications.bib")

# 2. Helper function to ignore accents, hyphens, and case
normalize_text <- function(text) {
  text <- tolower(text)
  text <- chartr("áéíóúñü", "aeiounu", text)
  text <- gsub("-", " ", text)
  return(text)
}

# 3. Define who you are looking for
target_author <- "villalpando sanchez"

# 4. Search the bib file
idx <- sapply(bib, function(entry) {
  authors_str <- paste(format(entry$author), collapse = " ")
  clean_authors <- normalize_text(authors_str)
  grepl(target_author, clean_authors, fixed = TRUE)
})

# 5. Check if we found anything
if (sum(idx) > 0) {
  # Subset to only the author's papers
  author_bib <- bib[idx]
  
  # 6. Extract years safely (assigns year 0 if a year is missing so it doesn't break)
  years <- sapply(author_bib, function(x) {
    if (is.null(x$year)) return(0) else return(as.numeric(x$year))
  })
  
  # Sort the list descending by year
  author_bib <- author_bib[order(years, decreasing = TRUE)]
  
  # 7. Print the formatted references AND stop it from re-sorting alphabetically!
  print(author_bib, .opts = list(style = "markdown", 
                                 bib.style = "authoryear", 
                                 sorting = "none"))
  
} else {
  # Print this if no matches are found
  cat("not yet, but working on it")
}
```
